name: Idaho DOPL Electrical Board License Search

agency.name: Idaho Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses

updateFrequency: unknown; verify against DOPL online services before relying on freshness assumptions
licenseTypesIncluded: Idaho Electrical Board contractor, limited contractor, journeyman, master, and related electrical license classes exposed by DOPL online services
knownExclusions: This source is limited to Idaho Electrical Board records and does not represent contractor registration, plumbing, HVAC, public works, asbestos, local permits, or business-registration records.
Solar coverage is limited to electrical work that falls within Idaho electrical licensing; non-electrical solar construction may require contractor registration or other authorization.
The lookup is hosted in DOPL online services; adapter work must review public search controls before automation.
rateLimitNotes: No adapter is implemented. Do not automate DOPL online-services pages unless official terms, result limits, and technical controls are reviewed.
publicRecordsNotes: Official lookup metadata only. Absence from this source is not proof that an electrical credential, permit, local authorization, or related contractor registration does not exist elsewhere.
officialLookupReviewNotes: The official Idaho Electrical Board page links a DOPL online-services license search for electrical records.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: No official stable bulk download has been confirmed for Idaho electrical licenses in this phase.
researchNotes: Keep this source separate from DOPL contractor registration because electrical contractors and electrical personnel are regulated through a distinct DOPL board.
verificationCaveats: This source covers Idaho Electrical Board records, not every Idaho construction, solar, local permit, or business-registration record.
No matching record means no match in this source at the checked time, not proof that an authorization does not exist elsewhere.
verificationNotes: No supported sync or verification adapter is exposed while official lookup behavior and allowed automation remain under review.
maintainerNotes: Future adapter research should distinguish contractor, limited contractor, journeyman, master, and permit-related records.

researchEvidence.note: Official Idaho Electrical Board page reviewed; it links DOPL online-services license search and lists contractor, limited contractor, journeyman, master, and related electrical license classes.

blocker.summary: The official path is lookup-oriented and no stable, documented machine-readable interface has been adapter-reviewed with offline fixtures.
